verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents daily continuous monitoring with proactive email notifications to admins when tests fail or change status. It also says it helps detect and remediate misconfigurations, including auto-generated infrastructure-as-code fixes, which supplies the context to fix a finding. Drift detection with a review/revert drift log is documented for Azure Government resources, but alerting on that drift is not described. Slack and Jira notifications and ticketing sync are documented only for vendor risk and access-review tasks, so they do not count here. missing for 10: Slack or ticketing delivery of control-failure alerts, explicit alerting on configuration drift, detail on what context each alert carries, independent or hands-on corroboration
